title: Sentinel Project Registry
description: Static shape for the top-level project registry (S2, ML-DEVOS-RFC-001). This is an INDEX of governed-project registrations only -- never authoritative project memory, task state, evidence, requirements, risks, capability state, or local governance. Those remain in the project's own repository / .devos/ overlay; the registry only points to them. No project entry is authorized in S2 -- validate-project-registry.mjs additionally enforces, as an S2-scope closure invariant on top of this schema, that `projects` remains empty until a PROJECT_ONBOARDING decision authorizes an entry.

project_id.description: Stable identifier, unique within this registry. validate-project-registry.mjs rejects a duplicate project_id.

repository.description: Repository locator (e.g. owner/repo), independent of Sentinel core.

overlay.description: Where and how this project's own overlay lives. Never implies the project's application source moved into this monorepo (CORE-015).

onboarding_decision_id.description: brain/DECISION_LOG.md entry authorizing onboarding. MUST be a non-null, non-empty string when status is ACTIVE (RFC future registry-entry invariant: no ACTIVE project without an onboarding decision reference).

onboarding_adr_id.description: ADR recording the onboarding, if one exists yet.
